/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/0/items.source_en: Stay longer at the spots you love, skip the ones you don't, and adjust on the fly without waiting for other guests to regroup.
Free hotel pickup and drop-off in Seoul downtown means no early-morning subway transfers and no late-evening shuttle stress.
A licensed Korean driver-guide adds local context, recommends meal stops, and adapts the route to weather or traffic in real time.

/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/0/title.source_en: Why a private charter wins on flexibility

/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/1/items.source_en: If you want one strong day of Korean nature and K-drama spots, the Gapyeong loop covers the most beloved tourist landmarks for couples and families.
If you want meaning plus downtime, the DMZ-and-Paju pairing works especially well for adult travelers and history-curious guests.
If your group includes kids who want rides, the ⟦G0⟧ and Korean Folk Village combination minimizes drive time inside Yongin.

/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/1/title.source_en: How to choose between the routes

/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/2/items.source_en: Traffic into and out of Seoul
Friday and Sunday afternoons can add 30 to 60 minutes to return time; the driver-guide will adjust your last stop accordingly.
Alpaca World and Legoland (both in Gangwon-do) carry an additional 60,000 KRW province-crossing fee paid in cash to the driver.
If you need more than 10 hours, an extra hour is 30,000 KRW paid in cash to the driver, subject to driver availability.

/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/2/title.tm: Was sich am Tag selbst ändert

/routeShapeIntro/subtitle.source_en: Pickup at your Seoul downtown hotel, then a fully flexible 10-hour day shaped by you and your driver-guide. Choose one of three recommended routes—Gapyeong nature, DMZ + Paju, or ⟦G0⟧ + Folk Village—or send your own itinerary.
